name: deep-research-mcp
description: Deep, multi-source, fact-checked research for Claude Cowork, powered by the Firecrawl and/or Exa MCP connectors. Fans out web searches, scrapes sources, extracts atomic claims, red-teams them with adversarial verification, and synthesizes a fully cited report. The MCP-powered sibling of the built-in deep-research plugin — use this when you have Firecrawl/Exa connectors and want their richer search + scrape coverage.
